answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the glacier.
